### Bible Pathway - August 21
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-21-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 26:1-3
Points:
- Believers must examine which voices they actively listen to and obey each day.
- Disobeying God's Word indicates that something other than God holds greatest influence in our lives.
- The spiritual downfall of Judah stemmed from turning away from God's voice toward false idols.
- Christians must tune their spiritual ears to discern God's voice amid competing worldly voices.
- Demonstrating love for God requires intentionally matching our daily choices to the guidance of Scripture.
